description:
Create new system-wide status categories and custom call dispositions in the Vicidial Admin panel.

Credentials:
- User: 6666
- Password: andromeda
- URL: http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php

1. Go to the 'Status Categories' section and create these 4 categories:
   - ID: SALES | Name: Successful Sales | Sale: Y | Dead Lead: N
   - ID: DNCLST | Name: Do Not Contact | Sale: N | Dead Lead: Y
   - ID: FOLLOWUP | Name: Requires Follow-Up | Sale: N | Dead Lead: N
   - ID: NOANSWER | Name: No Answer Dispositions | Sale: N | Dead Lead: N

2. Go to the 'System Statuses' section and create these 5 statuses:
   - ID: SOLD | Name: Sale Completed | Category: SALES | Human Answered: Y | Scheduled Callback: N
   - ID: UPGRD | Name: Upgrade Sale | Category: SALES | Human Answered: Y | Scheduled Callback: N
   - ID: DNCREQ | Name: DNC Requested | Category: DNCLST | Human Answered: Y | Scheduled Callback: N
   - ID: CBPEND | Name: Callback Pending | Category: FOLLOWUP | Human Answered: Y | Scheduled Callback: Y
   - ID: NOPICK | Name: No Pickup | Category: NOANSWER | Human Answered: N | Scheduled Callback: N
